title: Bob Maguire measures his girlfriend's implant with an RF detector

tellings.quote: Cuz I I just interviewed Bob Maguire whose girlfriend uh has an implant and he put like an RF detector over her head and can like measure the frequency coming out.
I have a video online of me moving this field meter across her head and watching that implant pul RF Transmissions
tellings.difference: Told firsthand by McGwier, who says the implant sends out pulses and that he has a video of it online; the story's telling is the host's secondhand account of measuring the frequency.
tellings.link_reason: Both describe Bob McGwier measuring his girlfriend's head implant with an RF meter and seeing it transmit.

as_told.title: Girlfriend's forehead implant pulses RF transmissions

plain: A man named Bob McGwier, described in his episode's title as a CIA contractor, says his girlfriend has an implant in her head that gives off radio signals he can measure. He tells it himself: he says he has a video online of moving a field meter, a device that picks up radio waves, across her head and "watching that implant pulse RF transmissions," meaning radio-frequency signals. Michels repeats the story on a later episode with the writer Whitley Strieber, calling him Bob Maguire. In that version Michels says McGwier put an RF detector over her head and could measure the frequency coming out. So one telling comes from the man who did it and the other is the host passing it on. It is told because an implant that sends signals would point to someone deliberately tracking or affecting her.
